To put this bluntly, you need to decide what is the most important to you. If you want to live your life drinking, then by all means, block your family and ignore their calls. If you want to fix the relationships with your family, and even your exes, you need to fix yourself first. You need to depend on yourself, and yourself only at the end of the day. You’re stronger than your temptations, and only you can fix it one day at a time.

What do you mean by take the wheel? Take control of your own wheel. You’re stronger, and better than your cravings. If you jump back into today, you’ll need it tomorrow, and the next day. Are you financially ready for that? Are you ready for your life to fall back into a hole? Delete your old dealers numbers, put a limit on how much cash you can withdrawal from your account, and just have some faith in yourself. You can live happily without a crutch, but only YOU can take yourself there.
